body:
Founder screenshot showed 'Unexpected token e, "email alre"... is not valid JSON' when registering with an existing email on the new iam.okemily.com SSO page. Root cause: every error path in player_email_auth.go (email/register, email/login) used http.Error (plain text), while sso_login.go's own JS unconditionally calls res.json() on every response regardless of status -- every error case (duplicate email, wrong password, disabled account, invalid JSON body) was broken the same way, not just registration. Fixed by switching every error response to writeJSON with the {"error": "..."} shape the rest of the codebase already uses. Added TestEmailAuth_ErrorResponsesAreValidJSON to prevent silent regression. go build/vet/test ./... all clean. IDUNA 7e88765. Rebuilt to ~/.local/bin/iduna -- iduna.service restart still needed to carry this live (same production-deploy restriction as the SSO route itself).

⚓ ☃
title: Fix: SSO login page crashed on any auth error (plain-text vs JSON response mismatch)
